outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) followed at a tertiary medical center in the United Arab Emirates
finding: Implementing a structured comprehensive multidisciplinary program for GDM management improved neonatal outcomes, including reduced macrosomia and neonatal hypoglycemia.
mod_finding: The comprehensive multidisciplinary GDM program was associated with an increased caesarean section rate.
